mapper.select: SELECT id, version, status, aggregation_strategy, medium_to_high_count, effective_from, effective_to FROM situation_rule_set WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND effective_from <= #{assessmentTime} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR #{assessmentTime} < effective_to) ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, rule_set_id, rule_code, event_type, metric_code, comparison_direction, medium_threshold, high_threshold, priority, enabled FROM situation_rule WHERE rule_set_id = #{ruleSetId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY priority DESC, rule_code ASC
